purpose: Review one finite Campaign140 catalog against all 153 complete logical definitions, the historical terminal registry and accepted local point-in-time schemas without opening any Campaign140 source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price or forward return.

accepted_local_schema_audit.inspection_method: pyarrow Parquet schema and manifest metadata only; no row group or column value opened

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: quarterly_forecast_surprise_persistence
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: current realized-minus-forecast profit-growth surprise minus the prior same-instrument surprise
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign139 fixed one signed same-period surprise and terminalized at only 123 non-overlapping cohorts. Requiring a second surprise can only reduce support, while differencing the terminal series after its result is an exposed lag/operator rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: annual_q4_vs_q3_profit_growth_seasonality_gap
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: annual profit_yoy minus the latest preceding Q3 profit_yoy for the same instrument and fiscal year
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: both announcements effective and both values finite
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Annual quality is the annual subset of the same seven-field quarterly history. A fixed Q4-versus-Q3 difference is a report-month subset of the terminal realized-growth level/acceleration family, not a new information state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: repurchase_plan_amount_to_last_profit_coverage
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: positive repurchase_planned_amount divided by the latest positive effective net_profit
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: finite positive amount and net profit
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.subset_or_combination: sparse repurchase event plus terminal profit scale
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Repurchase amount and share-ratio states have only 23 and 17 frozen potential cohorts versus the 200 minimum. A profit denominator does not create event dates and combines a capacity-terminal event with an exposed accounting scale.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: pledge_stress_confirmed_by_holder_concentration_change
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: pledge_total_share_ratio multiplied by negative holder_count_change_ratio after both disclosures are effective
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.subset_or_combination: share-pledge and holder-count terminal ownership branches
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Pledge fields completed their frozen branch, while holder-count ratio/absolute states stopped at 194 potential cohorts below 200. Multiplication after those outcomes is a post-exposure confirmation combination and cannot bypass the failed component capacity.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: quarterly_disclosure_margin_financing_reaction
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: three-session change in margin_net_buy_to_market_cap after a quarterly announcement
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: quarterly announcement and finite margin states
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.subset_or_combination: announcement timing plus terminal margin-financing flow
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: All four margin-financing states and quarterly timing states are already in the terminal registry. Selecting a post-disclosure window and differencing them now is a fitted event-window refresh of two exposed domains, not a new source relation.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: analyst_attention_and_management_forecast_uncertainty_consensus
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Analyst coverage/upgrade and forecast width/freshness/type alternatives are explicitly terminal. Their rank gap is a new arithmetic wrapper around exposed states and cannot be admitted merely because both schemas remain local.

selection.reason: Every proposal is a lag, subset, normalization, window or cross-source combination of capacity- or return-terminal mechanisms; accepted schema availability alone does not restore semantic independence.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Begin Campaign141 only from a genuinely new finite prevalue mechanism supported by accepted historically versioned point-in-time data; preserve all Campaign140 rejections and Candidate49 as the sole prospective ledger.
